mech.diff.name: Differential sticking
mech.diff.summary: The string is pressed into the filter cake against a permeable zone by the difference between mud hydrostatic and formation pressure.
mech.pack_cut.name: Pack-off: cuttings / poor hole cleaning
mech.pack_cut.summary: Settled cuttings or a cuttings avalanche have packed the annulus around the BHA or pipe.
mech.pack_shale.name: Pack-off: unstable shale (cavings)
mech.pack_shale.summary: Reactive or brittle shale has sloughed or collapsed into the hole and packed off around the string.
mech.pack_frac.name: Pack-off: fractured / unconsolidated rock
mech.pack_frac.summary: Blocks or loose grains from a fractured, faulted or unconsolidated formation have fallen in and bridged the hole.
mech.key.name: Key seat
mech.key.summary: Tool joints or the BHA have worn a slot into the wall at a dogleg and the larger BHA is wedged in it while pulling.
mech.ledge.name: Ledge / micro-dogleg / stiff BHA
mech.ledge.summary: The BHA has hung on a ledge or abrupt hole-angle change, typically at a hard/soft boundary or after a BHA change.
mech.under.name: Undergauge hole
mech.under.summary: Hole is smaller than the bit or stabilisers, usually after an abrasive section wore the previous bit or from swelling.
mech.mobile.name: Mobile formation (salt / plastic shale)
mech.mobile.summary: Salt or plastic shale is creeping into the hole and squeezing the string.
mech.foreign.name: Junk, cement or casing damage
mech.foreign.summary: Junk, cement blocks or green cement, or damaged/collapsed casing is locking the string.
reason.diff.circulation_full: Circulation is unrestricted, as expected when pipe is held by the wall rather than packed off
reason.diff.circulation_restricted: Restricted circulation points away from pure differential sticking
reason.diff.circulation_none: No circulation points away from differential sticking
reason.diff.operation_static: Pipe was stationary; differential sticking needs time against the cake
reason.diff.operation_sliding: Sliding without rotation leaves the BHA lying on the low side against the cake
reason.diff.lastMove_rotating: Pipe was rotating when it stuck
reason.diff.zone_permeable: Pipe is across a permeable / depleted zone where filter cake builds
reason.diff.not_zone_permeable: Stuck point is not across a permeable zone
reason.diff.overbalance_high: High overbalance gives a large sticking force
reason.diff.overbalance_moderate: Moderate overbalance can support differential sticking
reason.diff.overbalance_low: Low overbalance makes differential sticking unlikely
reason.diff.staticTime_long: Long static time increases the sticking force
reason.diff.flag_thick_cake: High fluid loss / thick filter cake
reason.diff.movement_neither: String cannot move up or down
reason.diff.angle_mid_high: Inclined hole puts the string on the low side against the cake
reason.diff.flag_cavings: Cavings at shakers point to hole instability instead
reason.diff.flag_poor_cleaning: Hole-cleaning problems point to a pack-off
reason.diff.mud_obm: Oil-based mud gives lower friction against the cake
reason.pack_cut.circulation_restricted: Circulation is restricted: annulus is partly packed
reason.pack_cut.circulation_full: Full circulation argues against a pack-off
reason.pack_cut.onset_gradual: Gradual pressure rise suggests cuttings accumulating
reason.pack_cut.onset_sudden: Sudden pressure rise can be a cuttings avalanche
reason.pack_cut.angle_mid: 30-60 degree hole is where cuttings beds form and slide
reason.pack_cut.angle_low: Low-angle hole is less prone to cuttings beds
reason.pack_cut.flag_poor_cleaning: Hole-cleaning problems (low flow, high ROP, fewer cuttings than expected)
reason.pack_cut.flag_drag_trend: Drag / overpull was building before sticking
reason.pack_cut.operation_tripping_out: Pulling into a cuttings bed is a classic trigger
reason.pack_cut.operation_sliding: Sliding does not agitate the cuttings bed
reason.pack_cut.operation_drilling: Pack-offs while drilling follow hole-cleaning loss
reason.pack_cut.lastMove_up: Pipe was moving up into the cuttings
reason.pack_cut.flag_cavings: Cavings suggest shale rather than cuttings
reason.pack_shale.circulation_full: Full circulation argues against a pack-off
reason.pack_shale.flag_swab: Swab / surge pressures can destabilise shale
reason.pack_frac.circulation_full: Full circulation argues against a pack-off
reason.pack_frac.onset_sudden: Sudden onset is typical of blocks falling from fractured rock
reason.pack_frac.flag_losses: Mud losses indicate fractures or vugs
reason.key.operation_tripping_in: Key seats stick the string when pulling, not running in
reason.key.movement_down_only: String can still be lowered but not pulled: classic key seat
reason.key.movement_up_only: String can be pulled but not lowered
reason.key.circulation_restricted: Restricted circulation points to a pack-off
reason.key.zone_shoe_dogleg: At a casing shoe or dogleg
reason.key.flag_prev_tight: Tight spot at this depth on a previous trip
reason.ledge.operation_tripping_out: Ledges can also catch the BHA when pulling
reason.ledge.movement_up_only: String can be pulled but not lowered: BHA is sitting on a ledge
reason.ledge.movement_down_only: String can be lowered but not pulled
reason.ledge.circulation_restricted: Restricted circulation points to a pack-off
reason.ledge.flag_bha_change: Recent change to a stiffer / larger-OD BHA
reason.ledge.flag_interbedded: Interbedded hard and soft formations form ledges
reason.ledge.flag_prev_tight: Tight spot at this depth on a previous trip
reason.under.zone_hard_abrasive: Across hard / abrasive rock that wears the bit gauge
reason.under.zone_shale_reactive: Reactive shale can swell the hole undergauge
reason.under.movement_up_only: String can be pulled but not lowered
reason.mobile.operation_static: Creep closes the hole while the pipe is static
reason.mobile.operation_tripping_out_tri: Creep is time-dependent and catches the string during trips
reason.foreign.flag_cement: Cement job, green cement or cement blocks in the hole
conf.high: Evidence points clearly to one mechanism. Still confirm with the checks below.
conf.medium: Likely, but another mechanism remains possible. Run the confirmation checks.
conf.low_insufficient: Limited information. Answer more questions or run the confirmation checks to sharpen this.
conf.low_mixed: Evidence is mixed. Treat the top two mechanisms as live and use actions safe for both.
warning.circulation_losses: Circulation lost with losses: monitor the well closely (flow check, pit levels). A pack-off can mask a kick or an underground flow.
warning.packoff_pressure: Never pressure up against a pack-off. Bleed trapped pressure before working the pipe and keep SPP below the limit for the open hole (fracture / losses).
warning.overbalance_high: High overbalance: check pore pressure and kick margin before any reduction in hydrostatic.
warning.diff_time: Differential force grows with time. Act in the first minutes rather than waiting.
check.pair.diff_pack_cut: Try low-rate circulation within the pressure limit. Full returns at normal pressure favours differential; high pressure or no returns favours a pack-off.
check.pair.diff_pack_shale: Check shakers for cavings and test circulation at a low rate. Cavings and high pressure favour shale; clean returns at normal pressure favour differential.
check.pair.pack_cut_pack_shale: Look at the shakers: angular, splintery cavings favour unstable shale; fine drilled cuttings with falling returns favour hole cleaning.
check.pair.key_ledge: Which way can you move? Down only (cannot pull) is a key seat; up only (cannot lower) is a ledge.
check.pair.ledge_under: Check the previous bit gauge and formation. Undergauge bit or abrasive section favours an undergauge hole; a BHA change or hard/soft boundary favours a ledge.
check.pair.key_pack_cut: Test circulation: normal pressure favours a key seat; restricted favours a pack-off.
check.pair.mobile_pack_cut: Check the formation at the stuck depth and the time since drilling it. Salt or plastic shale favours mobile formation.
check.pair.diff_key: Can the string be lowered? Moves down only = key seat. Cannot move either way across a permeable zone = differential.
check.pair.diff_mobile: Check formation at the stuck depth: salt or plastic shale = mobile formation; permeable sand with overbalance = differential.
check.prompt.circulation: Establish circulation at a very low rate and note the pressure and returns.
check.prompt.movement: Test carefully which direction the string can move (within pull and slack-off limits).
check.prompt.lastMove: Confirm from the driller which direction the string was moving at the moment it stuck.
check.prompt.zone: Check BHA position against logs / mud log to identify the formation at the stuck point.
check.prompt.overbalance: Calculate overbalance at the stuck depth from mud weight and formation pressure.
check.prompt.rotation: Check whether torque can be applied and held, and whether the string rotates.
check.prompt.angle: Check survey inclination at the stuck depth.
check.prompt.operation: Confirm the exact operation at the moment of sticking.
playbook.first.1: Stop pulling or slacking off against resistance. Do not force the string.
playbook.first.2: Record hookload (up, down, rotating), torque, SPP, flow, depth and time as your baseline.
playbook.first.3: Check the well: flow check and pit volumes. A pack-off or losses can hide a kick.
playbook.first.4: Apply the first action for the likely mechanism straight away. Most releases happen in the first minutes and sticking force grows with time.
playbook.first.5: Stay inside limits: maximum overpull, torque, trip load, and SPP/ECD for the open hole.
playbook.first.6: Notify the supervisor / drilling engineer and start the log.
playbook.prevent_pack.1: Keep annular velocity and rheology adequate for the hole angle; sweep and rotate/reciprocate on connections.
playbook.prevent_pack.2: Monitor torque, drag and returns trends and stop to clean the hole when they build.
playbook.prevent_pack.3: Make wiper trips and pump out of high-angle sections instead of pulling dry.
playbook.jar.opposite_up: Jar down (opposite to the last movement, which was up).
playbook.jar.opposite_down: Jar up (opposite to the last movement, which was down).
playbook.jar.opposite_unknown: Jar opposite to the direction of travel at sticking. The last movement is not known: confirm it with the driller before jarring.
tight_hole.now.1: You can still move the string, so this is a warning, not yet a stuck pipe. Stop forcing it.
tight_hole.now.2: Work the string through gently: circulate, rotate and ream the tight interval in both directions.
tight_hole.now.3: Record the depth and the overpull / drag at each tight spot.
tight_hole.now.4: Raise hole-cleaning effort: sweeps, rotation, flow rate within limits.
tight_hole.avoid.1: Do not push through with high overpull or heavy slack-off: forcing a tight hole is how pipe gets stuck.
calc.verdict.no_overbalance: No positive overbalance: differential sticking force is zero at these inputs.
calc.verdict.no_margin: No overpull margin left. Reduce hydrostatic and soak a release pill; pulling alone is not an option.
calc.verdict.good_margin: Safe overpull exceeds the estimated sticking force by a good margin. Jarring has a reasonable chance.
calc.verdict.thin_margin: Margin is thin. Combine jarring with a release pill and a hydrostatic reduction.
calc.verdict.overpull_below: Safe overpull is below the estimated sticking force. Do not rely on pulling: reduce ΔP and soak a pill.
playbook.diff.now.1: Keep circulating at the highest rate the hole allows. Returns should be normal.
playbook.diff.now.2: Slack off to set down weight, apply right-hand torque (hold within make-up limits) and jar down at maximum safe trip load. Repeat shots, do not wait.
playbook.diff.now.3: If kick margin allows and the supervisor approves, reduce hydrostatic: lighter pill / U-tube or lower mud weight. Size it in Calculate > Differential.
playbook.diff.now.4: Spot a pipe-release (oil-based or surfactant) pill across the stuck zone. Size it in Calculate > Spotting volume. Move small volumes periodically while soaking and keep working the pipe between movements.
playbook.diff.avoid.1: Do not leave the string static: the sticking force increases with time.
playbook.diff.avoid.2: Do not reduce hydrostatic without checking pore pressure and kick margin.
playbook.diff.avoid.3: Do not exceed maximum overpull or torque limits.
playbook.diff.confirm.1: Circulation is normal with unchanged pressure.
playbook.diff.confirm.2: Estimated differential force (Calculate > Differential) exceeds the overpull you can safely apply.
playbook.diff.confirm.3: BHA position matches a permeable zone on logs.
playbook.diff.escalate.1: No movement after the agreed soak time: run a free-point, then decide on back-off and fishing or a sidetrack.
playbook.diff.escalate.2: Pill cannot be spotted (circulation lost): treat as a combined problem and re-diagnose.
playbook.diff.prevent.1: Minimise overbalance and keep fluid loss low with a thin, slick cake.
playbook.diff.prevent.2: Avoid long static periods across permeable zones: rotate/reciprocate and keep surveys short.
playbook.diff.prevent.3: Use spiral or slick drill collars and minimise BHA contact area.
playbook.diff.jar.text: Jar down at maximum safe trip load with torque held. If there is no movement after several shots, alternate with jarring up inside pull limits.
playbook.pack_cut.now.1: Bleed off trapped pump pressure immediately. Do not pressure up against the pack-off.
playbook.pack_cut.now.2: Work the string down with low torque and jar down repeatedly. Increase torque gradually inside limits.
playbook.pack_cut.now.3: Once there is any movement or rotation, try low-rate circulation and step the rate up as pressure allows.
playbook.pack_cut.now.4: When free, circulate bottoms-up with high-viscosity sweeps, rotating and reciprocating, before resuming.
playbook.pack_cut.avoid.1: Do not jar up or pull hard: it packs the cuttings tighter.
playbook.pack_cut.avoid.2: Do not exceed SPP limits: risk of losses and fracturing.
playbook.pack_cut.avoid.3: Do not stop the pumps once circulation is re-established.
playbook.pack_cut.confirm.1: Circulation restricted or lost, with pressure rising before or at the moment of sticking.
playbook.pack_cut.confirm.2: Torque and drag trends were building and cuttings returns fell below expectation.
playbook.pack_cut.confirm.3: Hole angle 30-60 degrees or a long open-hole section.
playbook.pack_cut.escalate.1: No circulation after sustained working: consider a free-point, back-off and wash-over or a sidetrack.
playbook.pack_cut.escalate.2: Any sign of losses, kick or flow: follow well-control procedure first.
playbook.pack_cut.prevent.1: Keep annular velocity and rheology adequate for the hole angle; sweep and rotate/reciprocate on connections.
playbook.pack_cut.prevent.2: Monitor torque, drag and returns trends and stop to clean the hole when they build.
playbook.pack_cut.prevent.3: Make wiper trips and pump out of high-angle sections instead of pulling dry.
playbook.pack_cut.jar.text: Jar down (away from the cuttings). Never jar up against a pack-off.
playbook.pack_shale.now.1: Bleed off trapped pressure. Do not pressure up against the pack-off.
playbook.pack_shale.now.2: Work the string down and jar down. Start with low torque and increase inside limits.
playbook.pack_shale.now.3: Re-establish circulation at a very low rate once there is movement and clear cavings with sweeps.
playbook.pack_shale.now.4: Check mud weight against stability: raise it only inside the pore / fracture window. Check inhibition and fluid loss for reactive shale.
playbook.pack_shale.avoid.1: Do not jar up or pull hard against the pack-off.
playbook.pack_shale.avoid.2: Do not raise mud weight beyond the fracture limit or into a narrow window blindly.
playbook.pack_shale.avoid.3: Do not leave the open hole static for long periods.
playbook.pack_shale.confirm.1: Cavings at shakers: angular and splintery, larger than drilled cuttings.
playbook.pack_shale.confirm.2: Mud-log or offset records show unstable shale at the depth.
playbook.pack_shale.confirm.3: Torque and drag trends built before sticking.
playbook.pack_shale.escalate.1: No circulation after sustained working: free-point and back-off, or sidetrack.
playbook.pack_shale.escalate.2: Repeated tight hole after freeing: stop and review mud weight and inhibition before going on.
playbook.pack_shale.prevent.1: Hold stable mud weight and inhibition (OBM, KCl/polymer) for the formation.
playbook.pack_shale.prevent.2: Limit exposure time and surge/swab pressures.
playbook.pack_shale.prevent.3: Plan wiper trips and have contingencies for the shale intervals.
playbook.pack_shale.jar.text: Jar down. Never jar up against a pack-off.
playbook.pack_frac.now.1: Bleed off trapped pressure. Do not pressure up against the pack-off.
playbook.pack_frac.now.2: Work the string down and jar down at moderate torque.
playbook.pack_frac.now.3: Treat any losses (LCM) before circulating at higher rates and watch the well.
playbook.pack_frac.now.4: Once free, reduce ECD and surge pressures and clean out gently.
playbook.pack_frac.avoid.1: Do not jar up or pull hard.
playbook.pack_frac.avoid.2: Do not pressure up: fractured rock takes fluid and may fall in more.
playbook.pack_frac.avoid.3: Do not ignore flow or pit-gain signs: follow well-control procedure.
playbook.pack_frac.confirm.1: Sudden onset with falling returns or losses.
playbook.pack_frac.confirm.2: Formation is fractured, faulted, coal or unconsolidated at this depth.
playbook.pack_frac.escalate.1: No movement or circulation after sustained working: free-point and back-off or sidetrack.
playbook.pack_frac.prevent.1: Control ROP and ECD, minimise surge, and strengthen the wellbore with LCM where needed.
playbook.pack_frac.prevent.2: Avoid leaving the string static through known fractured intervals.
playbook.pack_frac.jar.text: Jar down. Never jar up against a pack-off.
playbook.key.now.1: Stop pulling. Do not keep overpulling: the BHA wedges deeper into the slot.
playbook.key.now.2: Slack off and jar down at maximum safe trip load. Rotate while working down if rotation is possible.
playbook.key.now.3: Establish circulation to keep the hole clean and lubricate.
playbook.key.now.4: Once free, ream or back-ream the key seat slowly, with rotation, before continuing the trip.
playbook.key.avoid.1: Do not jar up and do not continue to overpull.
playbook.key.avoid.2: Do not trip fast through the dogleg interval after release.
playbook.key.confirm.1: Pipe can be lowered but not pulled.
playbook.key.confirm.3: Sticking depth matches a dogleg or the casing shoe: use the free-point tool to compare.
playbook.key.escalate.1: No release after repeated down jar shots: free-point, back-off and fish, or sidetrack.
playbook.key.prevent.1: Limit dogleg severity and run a key-seat wiper or string reamers in the BHA.
playbook.key.prevent.2: Ream the interval before tripping out.
playbook.key.prevent.3: Track repeated tight spots on trips and treat them early.
playbook.key.jar.text: Jar down, then rotate and work down. Jarring up drives the BHA further into the slot.
playbook.ledge.now.1: Work the string away from the direction of travel at sticking: jar up if stuck going down, jar down if stuck pulling up.
playbook.ledge.now.2: Apply slow right-hand rotation while working to roll the BHA off the ledge.
playbook.ledge.now.3: Circulate while working to keep the hole clean.
playbook.ledge.now.4: Once free, ream the ledge with rotation, and consider roller reamers or a less stiff BHA.
playbook.ledge.avoid.1: Do not slack off heavy onto the ledge: it wedges the BHA.
playbook.ledge.confirm.1: String can be pulled but not lowered (stuck going in), or the reverse.
playbook.ledge.confirm.2: Recent BHA change or an interbedded hard/soft interval.
playbook.ledge.escalate.1: No release after repeated jar shots: free-point, back-off and fish, or sidetrack.
playbook.ledge.prevent.1: Control trip speed through known ledge depths and ream them.
playbook.ledge.prevent.2: Review BHA stiffness and stabiliser placement when changing BHA.
playbook.ledge.jar.text: Jar opposite to the direction of travel at sticking.
playbook.under.now.1: Jar up (if stuck while running in) within pull limits and apply rotation.
playbook.under.now.3: Once free, pull back above the tight section and ream it down slowly.
playbook.under.now.4: On the next trip, ream the last stands and never force a bit into undergauge hole.
playbook.under.avoid.1: Do not slack off heavy: it wedges the BHA tighter.
playbook.under.avoid.2: Do not drive the string through tight hole without reaming.
playbook.under.confirm.1: Previous bit came out undergauge or section is hard / abrasive.
playbook.under.confirm.2: String can be pulled but not lowered.
playbook.under.escalate.1: No release after repeated jar shots: free-point and back-off, or sidetrack.
playbook.under.prevent.1: Gauge-protected bits and stabilisers, and careful gauge checks.
playbook.under.prevent.2: Ream undergauge sections before the new bit goes to bottom.
playbook.under.jar.text: Jar up (opposite to the direction of travel) within pull limits.
playbook.mobile.now.1: Establish circulation and keep the string moving in both directions inside limits.
playbook.mobile.now.2: Jar opposite to the direction of travel and keep rotating if possible.
playbook.mobile.now.3: In salt, spot fresh water or under-saturated brine across the interval where allowed (not in shale).
playbook.mobile.now.4: Raise mud weight inside the fracture window to resist creep and ream the interval once free.
playbook.mobile.avoid.1: Do not leave the string static.
playbook.mobile.avoid.2: Do not use fresh water if the stuck zone is shale, not salt.
playbook.mobile.confirm.1: Formation at the stuck point is salt or plastic shale.
playbook.mobile.confirm.2: Torque and drag increased with time since drilling.
playbook.mobile.escalate.1: No release: free-point and back-off, or sidetrack. Salt creep gets worse with time.
playbook.mobile.prevent.1: Run adequate mud weight for the creep rate and ream through the interval.
playbook.mobile.prevent.2: Limit static time and use bi-centre bits where hole closure is expected.
playbook.mobile.jar.text: Jar opposite to the direction of travel at sticking and keep the pipe moving.
playbook.foreign.now.1: Jar opposite to the direction of travel at sticking within limits and avoid heavy overpull.
playbook.foreign.now.2: Circulate if possible and inspect returns for metal, rubber or cement.
playbook.foreign.now.3: Check cement records, bit and BHA condition and casing history.
playbook.foreign.now.4: Involve a fishing specialist early if junk is the cause.
playbook.foreign.avoid.1: Do not overpull aggressively: junk and cement can lock tighter.
playbook.foreign.avoid.2: Do not circulate hard if casing damage is suspected.
playbook.foreign.confirm.1: Returns contain metal, rubber, cement or casing pieces.
playbook.foreign.confirm.2: A recent cement job, dropped object or known casing wear.
playbook.foreign.escalate.1: Decide early on fishing or a sidetrack. Delay rarely helps.
playbook.foreign.prevent.1: Control the cement drill-out, junk baskets and casing wear.
playbook.foreign.jar.text: Jar opposite to the direction of travel at sticking, inside limits.
